title: Identifying and understanding determinants of high healthcare costs for breast cancer: a quantile regression machine learning approach.
summary: In 2,938 episodes from 2012–2018, chemotherapy drug and interval were prominent high-cost correlates; quantile analysis attributed 77% of reduced out-of-bag quantile loss to chemotherapy variables. Retrospective associations do not establish that changing a treatment or cost driver will causally reduce healthcare expenditures.
